about.en: HOODon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Robinhood Markets, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by HOOD shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding HOOD with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0x998f02A9E343EF6E3E6f28700d5A20F839fD74E6), BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
